about: Synthetic regression lines for the 2026-10-14 normalization additions (booking codes, month-first numeric dates, price ranges, +91/area-code phone digits, abbreviations, code-switching). No customer data. Same schema as local-tts-benchmark-phrases.json; `ref` is the current pipeline's own rendering, so it checks synthesis, not whether the rendering is good Telugu. Used for latency and synthesis-failure measurement, not for listening acceptance.
